title: Preservation of existing right coordinates
statement: Let $r,k$ be nonnegative integers, $x\in\mathbb{F}_2^{r+2k}$, $a,b\in\mathbb{F}_2$, and $j\in\{0,\ldots,k-1\}$. At the coordinate $r+2j+1$ in the transformed vector obtained by appending $a,b$ to $x$ and applying the paired-coordinate automorphism for $k+1$ pairs, the value equals the value at coordinate $r+2j+1$ of the image of $x$ under the paired-coordinate automorphism for $k$ pairs.
